snippet.title: The Knightling - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Adventure stirs, and a new legend is ready to begin. 

🛡️ A mysterious shield.
🦁 A lost knight.
🍄 A world waiting to be explored.

Jump, glide, bash, and become a true knight in The Knightling, a new fantasy action-adventure game about a little hero with a BIG shield and an even BIGGER heart! 

When Clessia’s legendary protector Sir Lionstone mysteriously disappears, it’s up to his plucky knight-in-training to take up his magic shield, become the champion the people need, and save the day on an epic quest featuring tons of exploration, combat, and platforming. 

All Heroes Start Small: 
Battle powerful foes, upgrade and master your abilities, and protect the people of the realm. Gather your courage and prove that even the smallest among us can be a hero!

The Best Offense is a Good Defense: 
Harness the power of Sir Lionstone’s magical shield in action-packed combat against the realm’s greatest challenges. Use the shield’s might to block, bash, parry, and create openings in enemy defences, then finish the job with huge attacks and combos.

Slide Into Adventure: 
Set off on an epic journey across Clesseia’s many varied regions, using the astounding power of the shield to slide, dash and soar across the land with ease! Explore the world, mastering platforming and puzzle challenges with the shield’s unique abilities to earn rewards for upgrades.

We are so excited to share The Knightling with you after over five years of development. Thank you for playing!


✨ Play The Knightling today! ✨
